  "title": "Dietary Macronutrient Content Alters Cortisol Metabolism Independently of Body Weight Changes in Obese Men",
  "source": "abstract",
  "text": "A low-carbohydrate diet alters cortisol metabolism independently of weight loss. In obese men, this enhances cortisol regeneration by 11beta-HSD1 and reduces cortisol inactivation by A-ring reductases in liver without affecting sc adipose 11beta-HSD1. Alterations in cortisol metabolism may be a consequence of macronutrient dietary content and may mediate effects of diet on metabolic health.",
